pages.title: Shockwave
pages.text: §lMax Level: §r III$(br2)§lApplies to: §r Mace$(br2)§lEffect: §r A falling smash that hits a target sends out a shockwave, dealing splash damage and knockback to nearby mobs.$(br2)Radius: 2.5 + 0.5 × level blocks$(br)Splash damage: 2 + 2 × level + fall distance × 0.5 (fall distance counts up to 20 blocks)$(br)Knockback: 0.3 + 0.1 × level$(br2)§lObtaining: §r Enchanting Table, loot chests, villager trades.$(br)Requires at least 1.5 blocks of fall distance; does not trigger while elytra gliding.
